general.title: L2P Analysis (Single)
general.instructions:
All input data uses mount name 'deg_table'. Attach your dataset with mount name 'deg_table' to replace the demo.

- (blank): auto-detects a single flat file or RDS from mount 'deg_table'
- Table: same as blank - auto-detects a flat file from mount 'deg_table'
- Filtered DEG: MOSuite moo-properties asset (mount 'deg_table') - after 'filter differential expression'
- All DEG (default): MOSuite moo-properties asset (mount 'deg_table') - after 'differential expression analysis'

Set 'Comparison' to the comparison ID in your data. Configure Basic Settings and run.

datasets.name: Demo DEG Table
datasets.help_text: Demo Mouse RNA-seq data (mount: deg_table). Replaced automatically when you attach your own dataset with the same mount name.

categories.name: Column Overrides
categories.help_text: Override auto-detected column names if needed

categories.name: Custom Pathways (Optional)
categories.help_text: Use your own pathway database instead of or in addition to built-in collections

parameters.name: DEG Table File
parameters.description: Select the differential analysis input type. Table - uses a single flat table with differential analysis information. Filtered DEG - uses data from Filter Differential Analysis. All DEG - uses data from Differential Expression Analysis.
parameters.help_text: Select the input mode for the attached deg_table data asset. Flat table modes support CSV/TSV/TXT/RDS files.

parameters.name: Comparison
parameters.description: Comparison ID to analyze (e.g. 'B-A'). Used to find diff_B-A.csv in All DEG mode and to derive column names for wide tables.

parameters.name: Species
parameters.description: Species for ortholog mapping. Non-human genes are converted to human before L2P analysis

parameters.name: Pathway Collections
parameters.description: Type one or more database codes. To run multiple databases together, join codes with commas and no spaces (e.g. H,REACTOME,KEGG). Available codes: H (Hallmark, 50 gene sets, fastest), GO, REACTOME, KEGG, WikiPathways, C2, C3, C5, C7, C8.

parameters.name: Gene Names Column
parameters.description: Name of the column containing gene symbols (e.g. GeneName for MOSuite output, Gene for other formats)

parameters.name: T-Statistic Column
parameters.description: T-statistic column name. MOSuite default 'tstat' works automatically for both All DEG and Filtered DEG modes. For a custom flat table with prefix-style columns (e.g. B-A_tstat), ensure Comparison matches the prefix.

parameters.name: Significance Column
parameters.description: Significance column name. MOSuite default 'adjpval' works automatically for both All DEG and Filtered DEG modes. For a custom flat table with prefix-style columns, ensure Comparison matches the prefix.

parameters.name: Fold Change Column
parameters.description: Fold change column name. MOSuite default 'FC' works automatically for both All DEG and Filtered DEG modes. For a custom flat table with prefix-style columns, ensure Comparison matches the prefix.

parameters.name: Select By Rank
parameters.description: Select genes by rank (recommended) or by significance/fold change thresholds

parameters.name: Select Top Percentage
parameters.description: Select top percentage of genes (vs fixed number)

parameters.name: Number of Top Genes
parameters.description: Number of top genes to select (if not using percentage)

parameters.name: Significance Threshold
parameters.description: P-value threshold for gene selection (if not using rank)

parameters.name: Fold Change Threshold
parameters.description: Fold change threshold for gene selection (if not using rank)

parameters.name: Minimum DEG Genes
parameters.description: Minimum number of DEG genes required per comparison

parameters.name: Minimum Pathway Hits
parameters.description: Minimum genes required per pathway to be considered

parameters.name: P-value Threshold
parameters.description: P-value cutoff for including pathways in results (0 = include all)

parameters.name: Use Built-in Gene Universe
parameters.description: Use built-in gene universe instead of detected genes

parameters.name: Use FDR P-values
parameters.description: Use FDR-adjusted p-values for pathway significance

parameters.name: Custom Pathway File
parameters.description: Select custom pathway file from attached data assets (TSV/CSV format). Leave blank to use only standard collections.

parameters.name: Pathway Name Column
parameters.description: Column name containing pathway names in custom file

parameters.name: Gene Symbol Column
parameters.description: Column name containing gene symbols in custom file

parameters.name: Number of Pathways to Plot
parameters.description: Maximum number of pathways to display in each plot

parameters.name: Pathway Label Max Length
parameters.description: Maximum character length for pathway names

parameters.name: Pathway Label Font Size
parameters.description: Font size for pathway labels

parameters.name: X-Axis Title Font Size
parameters.description: Font size for x-axis title

parameters.name: Y-Axis Title Font Size
parameters.description: Font size for y-axis title

parameters.name: X-Axis Tick Font Size
parameters.description: Font size for x-axis tick labels

parameters.name: Plot Top Pathways Up
parameters.description: Plot top upregulated pathways

parameters.name: Custom Pathways Up
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of specific upregulated pathways to plot (overrides top selection)

parameters.name: Plot Top Pathways Down
parameters.description: Plot top downregulated pathways

parameters.name: Custom Pathways Down
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of specific downregulated pathways to plot (overrides top selection)

parameters.name: Sort Bubble Plot By
parameters.description: Variable to sort bubble plot by

parameters.name: Bubble Size Variable
parameters.description: Metric to determine bubble size

parameters.name: Bubble Color Variable
parameters.description: Metric to determine bubble color gradient

parameters.name: Bubble Colors
parameters.description: Color scheme for bubble plots

parameters.name: Bar Plot Color
parameters.description: Color scheme for bar plots

parameters.name: Plot Width
parameters.description: Plot width in inches

parameters.name: Plot Height
parameters.description: Plot height in inches
